identificationModule.officialTitle: PALbociclib CoLlaborative Adjuvant Study: A Randomized Phase III Trial of Palbociclib With Standard Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy Versus Standard Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy Alone for Hormone Receptor Positive (HR+) / Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2)-Negative Early Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm A
armGroups.description: Palbociclib at a dose of 125 mg orally once daily, Day 1 to Day 21 followed by 7 days off treatment in a 28-day cycle for a total duration of 2 years, in addition to standard adjuvant endocrine therapy for a duration of at least 5 years.

armGroups.label: Arm B
armGroups.description: Standard adjuvant endocrine therapy for a duration of at least 5 years.
